title: Amazon Connect Fullstack Developer
description:
**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a Mid-Level Software Development and Testing Engineer with strong experience in Amazon Connect and AWS. The ideal candidate will be skilled in full-stack development (Python, React) and also capable of performing manual testing to validate end-to-end contact center flows. Additionally, this role requires providing support and maintenance for deployed solutions.

ShyftLabs is a growing data product company that was founded in early 2020 and works primarily with Fortune 500 companies. We deliver digital solutions built to help accelerate the growth of businesses in various industries, by focusing on creating value through innovation.

### **Job Responsibilities:**

* **Design & Development**
* Build and enhance Amazon Connect contact flows for calls and chat with Lambda, Lex, and third-party integrations.
* Develop backend services in Python or Node.js.
* Develop agent/customer interfaces in React (JavaScript).
* Integrate with AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, Lex, DynamoDB, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudFormation, Q in Connect, Kinesis, Secrets Manager, CloudFront).

### **Basic Qualifications:**

* Strong debugging, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to balance security, cost-effectiveness, and scalability in solution design.

* Python: Backend services for Lambda.

* Manual Testing: Test design, execution, defect tracking, and
* automation basics.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Terraform: Infrastructure as Code for AWS.
* GitLab: Source control & CI/CD pipelines.

*We are proud to offer a competitive salary alongside a strong insurance package. We pride ourselves on the growth of our employees, offering extensive learning and development resources.*

title: 1004-Staff Engineer-Full Stack (MVC)
description:
Engineering at Innovaccer

With every line of code, we accelerate our customers' success, turning complex challenges into innovative solutions. Collaboratively, we transform each data point we gather into valuable insights for our customers. Join us and be part of a team that's turning dreams of better healthcare into reality, one line of code at a time. Together, we're shaping the future and making a meaningful impact on the world.

About the Role

At Innovaccer, we’re looking for exceptional **Senior Staff Software Engineers** who are passionate about solving complex problems, building systems at scale, and redefining how software is engineered in the AI era.

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you’ll operate across multiple teams and technical domains, taking ownership of some of our most challenging engineering problems. You’ll combine deep hands-on coding with architecture, system thinking, and technical leadership to build scalable, reliable, and intelligent platforms that create meaningful impact in healthcare.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, AI, and other technical leaders to turn ambiguous problems into simple, scalable, and durable solutions. You’ll influence architecture and engineering direction, raise the technical bar, and help teams move faster without compromising engineering quality.

We’re looking for exceptional builders and technical leaders who are energized by hard problems, challenge assumptions, thrive in ambiguity, and have a strong bias toward ownership and action.

AI-native engineering is central to how we build at Innovaccer. You’ll be expected to use AI coding agents and the AI Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) as an integral part of your engineering practice—and help other engineers adopt these practices effectively.

A Day in the Life

* + Own and drive large, cross-team technical initiatives from problem definition and architecture through implementation, deployment, and production.
  + Design and build highly scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable full-stack and distributed systems.
  + Solve complex technical problems that cross service, product, platform, and organizational boundaries.
  + Remain deeply hands-on—designing, coding, debugging, reviewing, and improving production systems.
  + Use AI coding agents and AI-assisted development extensively across design, implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, code review, and documentation.
  + Champion AIDLC / AI-native engineering practices and help teams evolve their development workflows to take advantage of AI.
  + Think beyond individual services and features, understanding system-wide dependencies, trade-offs, failure modes, and customer impact.
  + Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, eliminate systemic technical debt, and improve engineering velocity, reliability, and developer experience.
  + Lead architecture and design discussions across teams and influence technical direction through strong engineering judgment and technical credibility.
  + Partner with Product, AI, Design, and Engineering leaders to translate ambiguous business and customer problems into technical strategies and executable solutions.
  + Establish reusable architectural patterns, engineering practices, and technical standards across teams.
  + Mentor Senior Engineers and SDE3s and help develop the next generation of technical leaders.
  + Proactively identify important problems before they become incidents, customer issues, or organizational bottlenecks.

What You Need

* 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a demonstrated track record of building and operating complex production systems.
* Deep hands-on expertise in software engineering, system design, distributed systems, and cloud-native architectures.
* Strong coding skills with depth in one or more areas and the ability to work effectively across the full stack.
* Strong experience with Java, Python, Node.js, TypeScript, React, or equivalent modern technologies.
* Strong understanding of databases, APIs, messaging, caching, observability, security, reliability, scalability, and cloud infrastructure.
* Demonstrated experience driving architecture and technical initiatives across multiple teams.
* Proven ability to take ambiguous, high-impact problems and drive them from problem definition through production.
* Strong engineering judgment and ability to balance velocity, scalability, reliability, security, cost, and long-term maintainability.
* Strong hands-on proficiency with AI coding tools is required. Experience with tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent AI coding agents.
* Practical experience with AIDLC / AI-native development, including AI-assisted design, coding, testing, debugging, code review, evaluation, and iterative development.
* Strong system-thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to reason across multiple layers of a technology stack.
* Ability to influence technical decisions without relying on organizational authority.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, AI, and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ownership, curiosity, bias for action, and continuous learning.

**Good to Have**

* Hands-on experience building Agentic AI applications or production AI workflows.
* Experience with LLMs, RAG, tool calling, MCP, AI agents, agent orchestration, or multi-agent systems.
* Experience designing AI-native or agentic architectures.
* Experience with AI evaluation, guardrails, observability, and runtime monitoring.
* Experience helping organizations adopt AIDLC and AI-augmented engineering practices.
* Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Kafka, Temporal, or similar cloud-native technologies.
* Experience defining engineering standards, architectural patterns, or platform-wide technical strategies.

About Innovaccer

Innovaccer builds software that helps hospitals, clinics, and health insurance companies make sense of all the scattered data they deal with every day — patient records, appointments, insurance claims, lab results — and turns it into something useful and actionable.

Think of a typical hospital: patient information often lives in a dozen different systems that don't talk to each other well. This causes delays in scheduling, slows down doctors, and makes it harder to catch health problems early. Innovaccer's platform connects all of that data together, and increasingly, uses AI "agents" to actually do some of the manual work for healthcare teams — things like scheduling appointments, preparing insurance paperwork, or drafting clinical notes — so that staff can spend more time with patients and less time on admin work.

Some of the largest healthcare systems in the US — including CommonSpirit Health, Atlantic Health, and Banner Health — use Innovaccer's platform today.

The company is also investing heavily in this direction: in June 2026, Innovaccer signed a multi-year partnership with AWS to run its AI agents at a much larger scale, using AWS's cloud AI tools (Amazon Bedrock) and healthcare-specific data infrastructure (AWS HealthLake). This is a strong signal of where the platform — and this engineering team — is headed next. For more information, visit www.innovaccer.com and check us out on YouTube, Glassdoor, LinkedIn, Instagram, and the Web.

**Here’s What We Offer**

* Generous Leaves: Enjoy generous leave benefits of up to 40 days.
* Parental Leave: Leverage one of industry's best parental leave policies to spend time with your new addition.
* Sabbatical: Want to focus on skill development, pursue an academic career, or just take a break? We've got you covered.
* Health Insurance: We offer comprehensive health insurance to support you and your family, covering medical expenses related to illness, disease, or injury. Extending support to the family members who matter most.
* Care Program: Whether it’s a celebration or a time of need, we’ve got you covered with care vouchers to mark major life events. Through our Care Vouchers program, employees receive thoughtful gestures for significant personal milestones and moments of need.
* Financial Assistance: Life happens, and when it does, we’re here to help. Our financial assistance policy offers support through salary advances and personal loans for genuine personal needs, ensuring help is there when you need it most.

Innovaccer is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status, feel valued and empowered.

**Disclaimer:** Innovaccer does not charge fees or require payment from individuals or agencies for securing employment with us. We do not guarantee job spots or engage in any financial transactions related to employment. If you encounter any posts or requests asking for payment or personal information, we strongly advise you to report them immediately to our HR department at px@innovaccer.com. Additionally, please exercise caution and verify the authenticity of any requests before disclosing personal and confidential information, including bank account details.

For more information, please visit innovaccer.com. Check us out on YouTube, Glassdoor,LinkedIn and Web.

title: Frontend / Full Stack Developer
description:
**Frontend / Full Stack Developer**

**Location:** Hapur, Uttar Pradesh, India  
**Work Arrangement:** On\-site  
**Contract:** Full\-time

**About GCRS Group**

GCRS Group is a global regulatory consultancy supporting businesses across cosmetics, fragrance, personal care, food supplements, medical devices and other regulated consumer products.

Our services include cosmetic safety, regulatory compliance, responsible person services, market access, product stewardship and brand protection across international markets.

We are expanding our technology capabilities and are looking for a **Frontend / Full Stack Developer** to help create modern, responsive and scalable digital products and applications for GCRS.

**The Role**

You will be responsible for developing user\-facing applications while also having the ability to work across the backend where required.

You will work closely with UI/UX designers, backend developers, product stakeholders and business teams to turn concepts and requirements into functional digital products.

The role will involve building new features, improving existing applications, integrating APIs, troubleshooting technical issues and ensuring that our products provide a fast, intuitive and reliable user experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop responsive and user\-friendly web applications
* Build reusable frontend components
* Convert UI/UX designs into functional interfaces
* Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs
* Develop and maintain application features
* Work with backend developers on full\-stack functionality
* Optimize applications for speed and performance
* Ensure compatibility across modern browsers and devices
* Identify and resolve frontend and application issues
* Write clean and maintainable code
* Participate in code reviews and technical discussions
* Implement appropriate testing practices
* Work with designers to ensure accurate implementation of designs
* Collaboration with product and business stakeholders
* Maintain technical documentation where required
* Support deployment and maintenance of applications
* Improve accessibility and usability
* Contribute to frontend development standards
* Identify opportunities for automation and technical improvement

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a developer who combines strong front\-end skills with a broader understanding of full\-stack application development.

You should have a strong eye for detail and care about both technical quality and the user experience.

**Essential Experience and Skills**

* Experience in frontend or full\-stack development
* Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Experience with React, Next.js, Vue or a similar modern framework
* Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs
* Understanding of responsive web design
* Knowledge of Git and version Control
* Understanding of browser compatibility and web performance
* Good debugging and problem\-solving skills
* Understanding of basic backend concepts
* Ability to work with databases and APIs
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to understand UI/UX designs and implement them accurately
* Ability to work collaboratively with technical and non\-technical teams

**Desirable Experience**

* TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL and other relational or modern database technologies.
* Hands\-on knowledge of cloud deployment, authentication and authorization systems.
* A background in developing dashboards and data\-intensive applications.
* Experience with automated testing frameworks and AI\-enabled application development

**What Success Will Look Like**

Within your first six months, you will have:

* Delivered high\-quality frontend features
* Improved existing interfaces and application performance
* Worked effectively with the UI/UX and backend teams
* Contributed to scalable frontend architecture
* Reduced recurring technical issues
* Improved the consistency and usability of our digital products
* Delivered projects within agreed timelines
* Contributed to a stronger development workflow

**Why Join Us?**

You will join a growing international organisation where technology is becoming an increasingly important part of our services and operations. You will have the opportunity to work on new products rather than simply maintaining legacy systems, with scope to grow into a senior developer, full\-stack or technical leadership role.

**Important:** This is a **fully on\-site role based at the GCRS office in Hapur, Uttar Pradesh**. Candidates must be willing to **work from the Hapur office five days a week**.
